system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Its system prompt is structured in general-, agent-, and environment-level instructions.
system_prompt_style.note: SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE in are/simulation/agents/default_agent/prompts/system_prompt.py composes general/agent/environment sections with <<tool_descriptions>>, notification and time placeholders; notifications injected each step.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Tools and environment descriptions are provided via system prompts alongside the notification policy configuration.
env_context_strategy.note: Agent explores app state via read tools; notifications injected pre-step. No line numbers available for repo files.

context_compaction.note: Agent loop/history code not in bundle (truncated); paper says context overflow terminates the agent.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Observation: [This will be provided by the system - DO NOT generate this yourself]

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The agent performs one tool call per step, formatted as a JSON.
tool_call_format.note: Default JSON-in-text; REACT_LOOP_CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT exists (paper: code execution not released). Paper: avoids model-specific tool calling APIs.

tool_count.note: Tools depend on scenario apps (Mobile: 101 tools per paper Sec. 2.2); no fixed harness tool list.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Apps are collections of tools that interact with a data source.
edit_primitive.note: No code-file editing primitive; domain is app APIs.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: these methods are automatically converted into properly formatted tool descriptions that agents can understand and use.
tool_schema_source.note: MCP compatibility stated in paper Sec. 2.1.1.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: ARE can also connect with external APIs through MCP com-
protocol_standardization.note: _apply_a2a_config in scenario_runner.py is ARE's own Agent2Agent app-agent mode, not the A2A protocol.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our implementation is a ReAct loop (Yao et al., 2023) with some additions.
loop_primitives.note: Pre/post-step hooks with notification injection; environment is event-based.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Take one action at a time and complete the thought/action/observation cycle before proceeding.

multi_agent_topology.note: orchestrator_workers reachable via a2a_app_prop (app sub-agents); Gaia2 Agent2Agent split uses r=1.

delegation_mechanism.note: Opt-in subagent_spawn via AppAgentBuilder when a2a_app_prop > 0.

human_in_loop.note: User is simulated in scenarios; agent may ask user for clarification but no approval gate found in bundle.

state_persistence.note: run_scenario accepts prior agent logs; full resume path not visible.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Only message the user when completely done or if the task is impossible.
self_verification.note: ARE Verifier (LLM judge) grades for evaluation, not fed back to agent within a turn.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Each model is evaluated three times per scenario to account for variance.
retry_policy.note: Repeated runs are evaluation, not retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: maximum iteration count (200 steps) or not passing verification at the end of a turn.
termination_condition.note: send_message_to_user ends turn; context overflow terminates agent.

timeouts.note: cli_executor uses timeout=30 per CLI call (gaia2-cli stack).

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: While our current implementation stores data in memory
execution_isolation.note: Default agent calls simulated in-process app tools; gaia2-cli stack uses containers.

permission_model.evidence_quote: """Build exec-approvals.json for unrestricted Gaia2 exec usage."""
permission_model.note: From gaia2-cli stack; tools role-scoped per paper.

tracing.evidence_quote:
executed events are
stored in anEventLogwith detailed metadata
tracing.note: Quote spans a line break; JsonScenarioExporter imported in scenario_runner.py.

replayability.evidence_quote: complete auditability—all actions can be replayed and analyzed

target_domain.evidence_quote: A research environment for simulating complex, real-life tasks that require multi-step reasoning and dynamic adaptation.
